t: Seder tepillat yom sheni utepillat chullo shel moed
s: Seder tepillat yom sheni utepillat chullo shel moed ubo y"ch seipim: bekol yom tob sheni shel galuyyot mitpallelin keseder hattepilla shel yom rishon, veken tzarik lomar qiddush hayyom ve"shehecheyanu". Veap al pi sheen anu nohagin bo qodesh ella mechamat sapeq shennistappeq laabotenu shello hayu yodein yom shenniqba bo hachodesh beeretz yisrael, mikkol maqom im lo yitpallelu bo tepillat yom tob o shello yomru bo qiddush hayyom ve"shehecheyanu" — yabou lezalzel bo lomar sheeno yom tob kelal, veal yede ken yabou gam ken laasot bo kol meleket aboda:

Beyom tob sheni shel pesach qorin beparashat moadot shebb"torat kohanim", dehaynu beparashat "emor": "shor o keseb vego'" ad sop pasuq "vaydabber mosheh vego'", vehammaptir qore battora kemo beyom rishon, umaptir bannabi bepesach deyoshiyyahu mi"vayyishlach hammelek" ad "lo qam kamohu". Vetob laasot ezeh dabar basseuda beyom sheni lezeker lisudat ester shehayeta beyom zeh, shebbo bayyom nitla haman:

Bechullo shel moed arbit veshacharit umincha — mitpallel tepillat hachol kedarko kol yemot hachol, raq tzarik lehazkir meen hamora baaboda, dehaynu "yaaleh veyabo". Veim lo hizkir — tzarik lachazor larosh, al derek shennitbaer besiman tk"b leinyan rosh chodesh. Veap im lo hizkir bitpillat arbit — tzarik lachazor larosh. Veeno domeh lerosh chodesh sheen tzarik lachazor, mittaam hamboar sham:
Veken tzarik lehazkiro bebirkat hammazon. Veim lo hizkiro — en tzarik lachazor larosh, mittaam shennitbaer besiman qp"ch, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Bemusap shel chullo shel moed veshel yom tob haacharon — mitpallel kederek shemmitpallel beyom tob harishon. (Ella shebbemiqtzat medinot en omerim "miqra qodesh" bechullo shel moed, kemo shennitbaer besiman tp"z ayyen sham). Ella shebbimdinot ellu sheomerim pesuqe qorbenot hammusapin — lo yomar pasuq "ubachamishsha asar yom vego'", ella yatchil "vehiqrabtem vego'":

Lo tiqqenu chakamim liqrot hahallel ella bishne yamim tobim harishonim shel pesach, abal lo bechullo shel moed veyamim tobim haacharonim, sheenan domim lechullo shel moed shel sukkot shettiqqenu liqrot bo bekol yom, lepi shekkol yom hu chaluq beqorbenotayv miyyom chabero umiyyom tob harishon, vahare kol yom hu kemoed bipne atzmo, mah sheen ken bepesach sheqqorbenot kol hayyamim hen shavin leqorbenot yom tob harishon, lepikak kullan tepelim leyom tob harishon, veen shum echad mehen kemoed bipne atzmo. Velo tiqqenu liqrot hahallel ella bapperaqim, dehaynu bammoadim shehen bain mizzeman lizman, ubehatchalat hammoed hu shettiqqenu liqroto:

Abal nahagu kol yisrael liqrot hahallel bedillug bechullo shel moed veyamim tobim haacharonim kemo shennahagu berosh chodesh. Velaken din hahallel bayyamim haellu hu kedino berosh chodesh lekol dabar, ayyen siman tk"b. Veayyen siman k"h ematay choletzin hattepillin bechullo shel moed. Veayyen besiman l"a im yesh lebarek al hattepillin bechullo shel moed, ayyen sham:

Beyom shelishi shehu rishon shel chullo shel moed qorin parashat "qaddesh li kol bekor" ad sop hasseder. Ubeyom b' shel chullo shel moed qorin parashat "im kesep talveh et ammi" ad "bachaleb immo". Beyom g' shel chullo shel moed qorin parashat "pesal leka" ad "bachaleb immo". Beyom rebii qorin parashat "bemidbar sinay" shebbeparashat "behaaloteka" ad "uleezrach haaretz". Veshabbat shel chullo shel moed leolam qorin parashat "pesal leka", apillu [hu] yom a' shel chullo shel moed, vaapillu hu chol hammoed shel sukkot, lepi shebbeparasha zo yesh bah gam ken meinyan shabbat vegam meinyan chullo shel moed, shenneemar sham: "et chag hammatztzot tishmor shibat yamim vego'", umikkan lamedu chakamim leesor baasiyyat melaka bechullo shel moed kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"l, ella shebbeshabbat matchilin min "reeh atta omer elay", kede sheyyukelu liqrot shiba qeruim. Ubishbii shel pesach qorin parashat "beshallach" ad sop hashshira, venohagin liqrot ad "ki ani Hashem ropeeka". Ubeyom tob acharon qorin "kol habbekor". Nimtza siman seder parashiyyot shel kol hach' yamim: "meshok", "tora", "qaddesh", "bekaspa", "pesol", "bemadbera", "shelach", "bukera". Vezeh hasseder lo yishtanneh mechamat hashshabbat shel chullo shel moed, ki im keshechal pesach beyom chamishi, sheaz qorin beshabbat, shehu yom a' shel chullo shel moed, parashat "reeh atta", shehi "pesol", ubeyom b' g' d' qorin: "qaddesh", "bekaspa", "bemadbera". Abal keshechal pesach beyom g' hare qorin parashat "pesol", beyomah, dehaynu beyom g' shel chol hammoed shehu shabbat. Ukeshechal pesach beyom z' o beyom a' — en sham shabbat kelal bechullo shel moed. Ubeyom bd"v en pesach kelal, kemo shennitbaer sham besiman tk"ch:

Vehattaam mizzeh hasseder hu, lepi shemmin harauy liqrot shemoneh parashiyyot ellu bishmonat hayyamim lepi hasseder shehem ketubim battora: harishona shehi "mishku" beyom a', vehashshemini shehi "kol habbekor" beyom ch'. Ella shebbeyom b' shehu yom tob yesh liqrot parasha hakkolelet kol hammoadim veyamim tobim, vegam huzkar bah yom chamishsha asar beperush, mah sheen ken bapparashot haqqodemot lah (vegam huzkar bah haqrabat haomer shehaya qareb bo, umittaam zeh qorin parasha zo beyom zeh ap beeretz yisrael). Ubeyom z' yesh liqrot parashat "beshallach", shehu meinyano shel yom shebbo bayyom niqra hayyam, abal bed' yeme chullo shel moed qorin kasseder shehen ketubot battora. Veim taa vehechelip parashat yom echad mehem beparashat yom chabero, ap al pi shello qara kasseder shehen ketubot battora — yatza, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"d leinyan seder parashiyyot shel qeriat shema:

Bime chullo shel moed qorin d' gabre — en pochatin mehem, lepi sheyyesh bahen qorban musap lepikak hosipu liqrot echad yoter mimmah sheqqorin besheni vachamishi. Veen mosipin alehem kemo shemmuttar lehosip beshabbat veyom tob al minyan haqqeruim, lepi shebbechullo shel moed yesh bo melaka laam, ubemah shehem mitacharim bebet hakkeneset yiqsheh beenehem haichur, veasur lehatriach et hatztzibbur:

Ubime chakme hammishna vehaggemara hayu kol had' qorin beparashat hayyom "qaddesh", "bekaspa", "pesol", "bemadbera". Veachar kak keshettiqqenu rabbanan saborae lehotzi seper tora sheniyya bekol yom liqrot bo parashat hammusapin shebbepinechas, dehaynu "vehiqrabtem vego'", azay en qorin bed' parashiyyot hayyom raq g' gabre, vehad' qore beparashat hammusapin, shehare bechullo shel moed asur lehosip al d' gabre. Veen lomar qaddish achar gemar parashat hayyom qodem qeriat parashat hammusapin kemo shennohagin beyom tob, lepi shebbeyom tob nishlam minyan haqqeruim, dehaynu Hashem gabre, beparashat hayyom, vehammaptir sheqqore beparashat hammusapin eno mimminyan haqqeruim kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"b, laken mapsiqin beqaddish benetayim, abal bechullo shel moed lo nishlam minyan haqqeruim, dehaynu d' gabre, ad leachar parashat hammusapin, laken en omerim haqqaddish ad leachar qeriat parashat hammusapin:

Bishbii ushemini shel pesach nohagin lomar battepilla ubaqqiddush "zeman cherutenu" kemo beyom tob harishon. Veen omerim "shehecheyanu" baqqiddush shel shette lelot, kevan shekkebar amaro bishte lelot harishonim shel pesach:

Veqore battora "vehiqrabtem vego'", kemo bechol hammoed. Umaptir bannabi bishmuel: "vaydabber david et dibre hashshira hazzot vego'", shehi gam ken shira kemo shirat hayyam sheqqareu battora, vegam medabber bah bitziat mitzrayim: "vayyishlach chitztzim vego'", "vayyerau apiqe yam vego'". Ubashshemini maptir: "od hayyom benob laamod vego'", lepi shebbelel pesach hayeta mappalto shel sancherib, shenneemar "hashshir yihyeh lakem kelel hitqaddesh chag vego'":
Im yesh mila bashshemini, omerim: "yom leyabbasha veku'", apillu keshechal bechol, mah sheen ken bishar yamim tobim, sheen omerim ella im ken chal beshabbat:

Shabbat bechol hammoed shel pesach o sukkot arbit shacharit umincha — mitpallel shel shabbat kedarko bekol hashshabbatot, ella shetztzarik lomar "yaaleh veyabo" baaboda. Ubemusap mitpallel shel chol hammoed, haynu: "atta bechartanu", "umippene chataenu ku'". Ella shetztzarik lehazkir shel shabbat qodem leyom hamora, dehaynu sheyyomar: "vattitten lanu Hashem elohenu et yom hashshabbat hazzeh veet yom hachag hazzeh ku', veet musap yom hashshabbat hazzeh ku', veet yom hachag hazzeh ku'", vechotem: "meqaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim". Veim taa vechatam "meqaddesh hashshabbat" bilbad, o "meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim" bilbad — en machazirin oto, kemo shennitbaer besiman tp"z:

Beshabbat shechal bechol hammoed shel pesach maptirin "haatzamot haybeshot", ubeshabbat shel chol hammoed sukkot maptirin bemilchemet gog umagog, lepi shettechiyyat hammetim atida lihyot benisan, umilchemet gog umagog betishre. Ubeshabbat shechal bechol hammoed pesach en mazkir meen hamora bachatimat birkat haptara shechotem: "baruk atta h' meqaddesh hashshabbat" bilbad, veeno omer: "veyisrael vehazzemannim", kemo keshechal shabbat beyom tob, shebbekol yom tob yesh haptara apillu kesheeno chal beshabbat, veaz hu chotem: "meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim", lepikak keshechal beshabbat tzarik lehazkiro bachatimat birkat haptara, kevan sheen hahaptara baa bishbil shabbat bilbad ella gam bishbil yom tob, abal beshabbat shechal bechol hammoed pesach en hahaptara baa ella bishbil shabbat bilbad, shehare en maptirin bannabi bishar yeme chol hammoed. Umikkol maqom, beshabbat shebbechol hammoed sukkot nohagin bimdinot ellu lachtom bahaptara gam "yisrael vehazzemannim", lepi shekkol yom vayom mechol hammoed sukkot hu kemoed bipne atzmo, kemo shennitbaer lemala seip v':

Nohagin liqrot megillat shir hashshirim beshabbat shechal bechol hammoed shel pesach, lepi sheyyesh bah meinyan yetziat mitzrayim. Veen mebarekin shum beraka al qeriatah, lepi shechiyyub qeriatah eno nizkar baggemara veeno ella minhag beolma veek yebarek aleha "vetzivvanu"? Veillu haya biqriatah chiyyub gamur — haya tzarik lekotbah al haqqelap kemo megillat ester. Vaapillu megillat ester shechayyabim liqrotah chiyyub gamur mittaqqanat hannebiim — ap al pi ken en mebarekin aleha kesheenah ketuba al haqqelap kedinah, qal vachomer limgilla zo vekayyotze, kegon megillat rut beshabuot, umegillat eka bet' beab, umegillat qohelet besukkot:

Im en shabbat bechol hammoed — qorin "shir hashshirim" beechad mishshene yamim tobim haacharonim shechal lihyot beshabbat. Veim chal yom z' beshabbat omer be"yotzer" happiyyutim shel shabbat chol hammoed, ubishmoneh esreh matchilin lomar happiyyutim shel yom z':
